legend: grey = walkable ground (floor, path, earth, flagstones as fits the scene)
ochre = difficult terrain (rubble, undergrowth, mud, shallow scree)
black = solid walls or impassable rock
dark purple = outside the play area, where nobody can stand: scenery that fits (cliff drop, solid bedrock, darkness, dense forest), never open water or walkable floor
magenta = openings at the map edge, painted as the path, doorway or stairs that leads away: Treppe nach oben
scene: a flooded crypt of three chambers joined by narrow corridors, an altar on a raised dais
